## What changed

## Checklist

- [ ] A changed value cites its provision in `citation` and links the official text in `sourceUrl`.
- [ ] `confidence` says how the value was read, and `note` explains anything conditional.
- [ ] A change in the law is a new version with `effectiveFrom`; the old rule is kept for dates before it.
- [ ] A test pins the change, and fails without it.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
